description: How long regulatory processes take and how they end, measured over each regulator's own records (e.g. ANEEL fine → appeal → decision; ANVISA public consultation → published rule): N, median, quartiles and range per figure, with method and limits. Figures are estimativa; a figure below the minimum N is withheld and has no number. Use for 'how long until ANVISA turns a consultation into a rule'. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

study.description: Optional. A study id (e.g. 'aneel_enforcement'), a regulator ('ANVISA') or a sector. Default: every study for your sectors.
